_readme: A sheet as an OUTSIDE source would describe it: compass row labels, in a different
order from this project's canonical down/left/right/up. Nothing about it is edited
by hand on the way in - SpriteFramesFactory maps the labels through Dir, which is
what makes dropping in a third-party or AI-generated pack a data operation rather
There is deliberately no PNG beside this file: it exercises metadata handling only.
VERSION 2 since M42, which added `portrait` - the square a face is cut from. An outside
pack has to declare one, and that is a real cost to this seam stated deliberately: a
sheet this build cannot fully read is refused rather than half-drawn, and the version
number is how the contract says what it needs. Measured from the art, like the anchor.
